messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu1' queue depth > 85% and request backlog increasing. Paging oncall: @sam. Priority: high.

sam: Ack — I'm on it, pulling the pool metrics and recent deploy logs.

ops-bot: Autoscaler check: cooldown_flag=true on pool dedicated-eu1 (manual override present). Last scale event 18m ago.

sam: That explains why autoscale didn't kick. Who set the override? nina, any recent experiments on eu1?

nina: Not for production, only flipped scale_policy for canary yesterday but I didn't touch cooldown or burst flags.

maria: Support: Customer ACME reporting increased 502s and timeouts since ~10m ago, multiple error spikes tied to eu-west traffic.

sam: Plan: 1) Enable burst capacity for dedicated-eu1 to buy time 2) Apply temporary per-customer rate caps for noisy routes 3) Canary fallback routing for the heaviest 5% traffic. Executing step 1 now.

sam: ```
# enable burst capacity (adds ~20% spare concurrency for pool)
controlctl pool update --pool=dedicated-eu1 --set=burst_enabled=true
```

ops-bot: Action result: burst_enabled=true on dedicated-eu1 — confirmed. Estimated capacity +18%. Autoscaler cooldown cleared by operator. :white_check_mark:

keith: Applying traffic shaping for public inference routes to limit single-customer concurrency:
```
controlctl route update --route=/v1/generate --set=max_concurrency=8 --scope=per_customer
```

ops-bot: Traffic policy updated, rules propagated to edge nodes (approx 10s). Canary limits: route /v1/generate -> fallback-model=compact-model v1 for 5% sample.

sam: Kicking a 5% canary to fallback-compact for top latency cohort. If stable, we'll widen to 20% after 10m.

maria: Notifying ACME: told them we enabled mitigations and will waive overage charges for any retry traffic generated by our fallback. Support ticket ID: S-11234.

keith: Metrics update: queue depth dropping from 86% -> 37% over 4m, p95 latency down 40%. Token throughput stable. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

sam: Good. Root cause notes: manual cooldown flag left on after maintenance deploy earlier, prevented autoscaler from reacting to surge. Filing follow-up: INF-4567 (investigate deploy automation leaving cooldown set). Handoff to nina for the postmortem and change.

nina: Ack — taking INF-4567. I'll remove manual override from our deploy playbook and add a post-deploy check to ensure cooldown=false.

ops-bot: Canary widened to 20% fallback-compact for heavy cohort as p95 remained stable.

sam: Leaving the pool with burst_enabled=true for the next 30m while we monitor, then revert if traffic normalizes. If anything regresses, reopen immediately.

pagerbot: Incident state: mitigations applied and stable. Closing alert for now — reopen if queue depth > 70% or p95 latency increases. :lock_with_key:
